users.description: One account per person. A secretary belongs to a single store.
users.sentBody: An email was sent to {email}. The link lets them choose a password.
users.deactivateBody: Access is blocked immediately and the person is signed out. History is kept; you can reactivate the account.

lists.title: Dropdown lists
lists.description: Each list feeds the app’s menus. Renaming an item updates it everywhere; an item in use is archived instead of deleted.
lists.usage: {count, plural, =0 {not used} one {used # time} other {used # times}}
lists.systemHint: Used by the app’s rules: it can be renamed or archived, not deleted.
lists.archiveBody: It will no longer appear in menus. Existing orders and charges keep it, so history stays accurate. You can restore it.
lists.deleteBody: This item is not used anywhere: it will be deleted permanently.
lists.fixedBody: Order statuses drive the tracking of each pair of glasses: they cannot be changed.

products.typesDescription: The three stocked product types. Lenses are not a product: they are never in stock.
products.categoriesDescription: Stock is tracked per category. A new price applies to new orders; past orders keep their price.
products.archiveBody: It will no longer appear in new orders or purchases. Stock and history stay visible. You can restore it.
products.thresholdsDescription: An alert is sent when the quantity goes down to this threshold or below. Empty cell: no alert.

fields.title: Order fields
fields.description: The built-in measurement fields and your custom fields. For each one choose: hidden, optional or required.
fields.typeLocked: The type cannot change after creation.
fields.optionsHint: English choices follow the same order; empty = same label as in French.
fields.used: {count, plural, =0 {never filled} one {filled in # order} other {filled in # orders}}
fields.cannotDelete: Already filled in orders: hide it instead.
fields.deleteBody: No order has filled it: it will be deleted permanently.
fields.previewHint: What the secretary will see in the Measurements step.
fields.photoHint: Photo added after the order is saved

stores.title: Stores and lab
stores.description: The stores where clients order and the lab where glasses are prepared. The prefix appears in every order number.
stores.name: Name

chargeLocations.title: Charge locations
chargeLocations.description: The locations offered when you enter a charge. Each store and the lab has its own; “General” holds shared charges.
chargeLocations.hint: Charges of “General” and other locations only count in the dashboard’s “All stores” view.

loyalty.title: Loyalty
loyalty.description: A client becomes loyal (⭐ badge and notification) when they reach this number of delivered orders, across all stores.

loyalty.savedNewLoyal: {count, plural, one {Threshold saved · # client becomes loyal} other {Threshold saved · # clients become loyal}}

notifications.title: Late orders
notifications.description: A notification is sent (to you and the store) when an order stays too long in the same status.
notifications.invalid: Each delay must be between 1 and 60 days.
notifications.hint: Checked every morning. One notification per order and status.
